'''Chasa''' was a hulking [[Gender/Legends|man]] who owned and operated a bar on [[Dolis 3]]. It was favored by [[Banner Sumptor]] and his [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] comrades during the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].
